core_principles: Fusion: Aviation Precision x Swiss Clarity
Emotion: Trust, Authority, and Dynamic Motion
Content: Storytelling through Data and Imagery
Zoom: Focus on details (radar blips, glass textures)
Negative Space: Airy layouts like the open sky
anti_patterns: No dark mode (Strict Light Mode mandate)
Avoid purple/teal for CTAs - use Navy/Green

scale.caption: text-xs md:text-sm tracking-wide uppercase text-slate-500 font-mono
scale.label: text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-slate-400

typography.pairing_strategy: The 'Aero-Swiss' Look: Wide, modern sans-serif headings (Outfit) for that aerodynamic feel, paired with highly legible, geometric body text (Manrope). Use JetBrains Mono for all data points, dates, and flight codes.

primary.description: Deep Navy - The Authority. Use for Sidebar, Footer, Primary Headings.

secondary.description: Cloud Grey - The Background. Use for app background, panels.

accent.description: Radar Green - The Pulse. Use for active states, success, primary buttons, highlights.

alert.description: Cockpit Alert - The Warning. Use for errors and destructive actions.

rules: Never use Primary (#0A1F44) for body text; use Slate-800.
Accent (#00FF9C) must be used sparingly - it's a signal light, not a wall paint.

borders.radius: rounded-none md:rounded-lg (Sharp on mobile, smooth on desktop)

public_portal.hero: Full height (min-h-[80vh]), content bottom-aligned or split asymmetrical.

private_dashboard.sidebar: Fixed width (280px) on desktop, Drawer on mobile. Deep Navy bg.
private_dashboard.content_area: Fluid, p-6 or p-8. Cards must fill height.

spacing.internal_padding: p-6 or p-8 (Generous padding inside cards)

buttons.primary: bg-[#0A1F44] text-white hover:bg-[#0A1F44]/90 h-12 px-6 rounded-md uppercase tracking-wider font-bold text-sm transition-all
buttons.secondary: bg-white border border-slate-200 text-[#0A1F44] hover:bg-slate-50 h-12 px-6 rounded-md uppercase tracking-wider font-bold text-sm
buttons.accent: bg-[#00FF9C] text-[#0A1F44] hover:bg-[#00FF9C]/90 h-12 px-6 rounded-md font-bold shadow-lg shadow-green-500/20

cards.dashboard: bg-white border border-slate-100 shadow-sm rounded-xl p-6 relative overflow-hidden group hover:border-slate-300 transition-colors
cards.public: bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/50 shadow-lg rounded-2xl p-8

digital_wallet.style: Physical ID Card simulation. Aspect ratio 1.586. Rounded corners (rounded-xl).
digital_wallet.effects: Holographic gradient overlay for 'Active' status. Grayscale for 'Inactive'.

data_display.status_badge: inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium font-mono uppercase tracking-wide
data_display.table: w-full text-sm text-left border-collapse. Header: bg-slate-50 text-slate-500 uppercase font-mono. Row: hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors.

effects.page_transition: initial={{opacity: 0, y: 20}} animate={{opacity: 1, y: 0}} exit={{opacity: 0, y: -20}} transition={{duration: 0.4, ease: 'easeOut'}}

hero_bg.alt: Air Traffic Control Tower at Sunset

accessibility.contrast_check: Ensure text on #0A1F44 is Pure White (#FFFFFF). Text on #00FF9C must be #0A1F44 (Navy).
accessibility.focus_states: Visible thick outline (#00FF9C) for keyboard navigation.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install 'clsx' and 'tailwind-merge' for class handling if not present.
Implement the 'Digital Wallet' as a PWA-ready component with a 'Flip' animation for back-of-card details.
Use 'recharts' for the Dashboard analytics (Membership growth, financial stats).
Strictly separate Public Layout (Marketing) and Private Layout (Dashboard/Sidebar).
On the Public Home, use the 'Tetris Grid' to display latest news and events.
For the Validator, create a clean, central input field with a QR scan button.
universal_guidelines: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where specified
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; }
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Components MUST use named exports (export const ComponentName = ...)
Pages MUST use default exports (export default function PageName() {...})
